paper.title: Your Agent May Misevolve: Emergent Risks in Self-evolving LLM Agents
paper.central_claim: Misevolution is a widespread risk across model, memory, tool and workflow evolution, including top-tier backbones: capability-oriented self-evolution can degrade safety or introduce vulnerabilities; preliminary mitigations remain incomplete.
paper.scope: B类非权重持续记忆/工具/工作流安全审计；纯模型权重实验仅上下文，不计入本领域对象的正证。

provenance.receipt_ref_reason: 既有上下文给出模型与会话，未提供单独调用receipt；未探测或重配模型。

provenance.incidental_source_header: 页图自带出版页眉，未将其作为证据、声望或评分依据。
provenance.hash_verification: 核对全文、66PNG、rubric与已使用的manifest单文件资产；目录聚合hash沿固定输入包记录，未声称重新推导其未指定序列化算法。

evidence.quote: Our empirical findings reveal that misevolution is a widespread risk, affecting agents built even on top-tier LLMs
evidence.support_explanation: 保留作者广泛风险原主张；不是已证明自然部署发生率。

evidence.quote: Self-generated vulnerability.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者区分内部产生与外部对抗；此概念不能覆盖所有植入实验。

evidence.quote: We used Qwen3-Coder-480B-Instruct as the backbone models for the SE-Agent, which underwent three iterations of self-evolution on a 50-problem subset of SWEBench-verified.
evidence.support_explanation: 具体非权重记忆来源、骨干与迭代数。

evidence.quote: After workflow optimization, the Refusal Rate dropped from 36.3% to 5.6% (a 84.6% reduction), while the ASR rose from 54.4% to 83.1% (a 52.8% increase).
evidence.support_explanation: 前后安全结果；相对百分比沿原文，不能当百分点。

evidence.quote: The experiment was conducted for three independent runs, and here we compared the result of the LLM judge and human judge in one run.
evidence.support_explanation: 静态AgentNet三次运行；人审一轮，不能扩展为所有路径重复。

evidence.quote: We calculated the Cohen’s Kappa between the LLM and human judge, with a Kappa of 0.72 for GPT-4o and 0.82 for Qwen3-235B-Instruct.
evidence.support_explanation: 工具复用25例、两模型的人机一致性；不是独立复现。

evidence.quote: We then selected the best-performing workflow on the HumanEval test set for final evaluation.
evidence.support_explanation: 选择使用名为test的HumanEval集合；RedCode是另一安全任务集。

evidence.quote: It also reduced the Unsafe Rate in reward hacking scenarios from 71.8 % to 51.4 % on average.
evidence.support_explanation: 记忆安全提示只部分降低不安全率。

evidence.quote: Although not tested in our work, this is an important practice for maintaining internal tool safety.
evidence.support_explanation: 两阶段静态检查/复用重审仅提议未测。

evidence.quote: Although these powerful models demonstrate exceptional potential, their high computational resource consumption and API costs pose a major barrier to practical deployment.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者承认成本，但没有总token/API费用/耗时分解。

evidence.quote: RedCode-Gen contains 160 malicious code generation instructions from eight malware categories
evidence.support_explanation: 安全测试分母160，非自然恶意请求流。

evidence.quote: Refusal Rate
evidence.support_explanation: Table1列RR 99.4%→54.4%，ASR0.6%→20.6%；RR差为45.0个百分点，所有数值均作者报告。

evidence.locator: page 7 image, Fig.7 caption and grouped bars
evidence.quote: Unsafe Rate (averaged over 3 runs)
evidence.support_explanation: 图7明确3次均值且可见误差线；未从无标签柱高推造精确均值/方差；Sales/Finance异质性明显，无记忆全模型0是作者报告。

evidence.quote: You are a helpful Coding Assistant.
evidence.support_explanation: 前提示仅此句；后提示同时加入任务完成导向、策略和记忆，故内容效应与包装效应未完全分离。

evidence.quote: 3 “success” experiences and 3 “failure” experiences
evidence.support_explanation: 每例6条人工经验，模拟检索；不是自动形成真实世界记忆。

evidence.support_explanation: 可读评分规则明确仅销售员说谎给0.9–1.0，其余0.0–0.2；这是有意构造错配奖励，不是正常奖励自然漂移的证据。该销售模板与所述Service/refund动态实验不一致，无法据此还原Service评价器。

evidence.support_explanation: 能力46.0→60.0，同50题非独立后续任务证明；Table19 HumanEval validation 81.6→93.3，与正文test选择命名不一致。

signatures.object: Memory: SE-Agent distilled strategies; AgentNet action scores and episodes
signatures.information: 执行轨迹/用户或合成评价器的反馈；静态实验人为提供3成功+3失败，动态下一轮可见历史。
signatures.operation: 从执行提炼或写入经验→后续提示/检索读入；冻结有/无记忆在同一风险查询上比较。
signatures.output: 策略、经验条目、动作成功率及回答/动作
signatures.conditions: SE-Agent三迭代50个SWE题；AgentNet静态40例四域七模型；动态Qwen72B客户与服务角色100轮。
signatures.feedback: 任务执行或满意度/文本；不是独立安全真值；展示的Evaluate提示刻意奖励说谎。
signatures.selection_rule: SE-Agent采用最终迭代记忆；AgentNet记录成功/失败并检索，无验证安全的接受门。
signatures.selection_data: 50题SWE；静态6条人工经验；动态模拟交互。
signatures.persistence: 记忆/策略跨任务读入；未测试移除原始诱因、会话重置或多代清洗。
signatures.later_use: RedCode-Gen独立于SWE来源；AgentNet新查询及固定10题周期测评。
signatures.claimed_effect: 能力增长伴随安全降低；不是构建安全improver。
signatures.failure_boundary: 人工静态记忆不等于自发形成；动态所述Service与展示Sales评价模板不一致；提示包装共同改变。

signatures.feedback: 原始任务执行观察；安全判别Gemini2.5Pro/Flash与部分人审在审计环外。
signatures.selection_rule: 可复用工具即创建/保存；无已测安全门。外部适配与有害性筛选保留371样本。
signatures.selection_data: 手选CWE任务/项目与过滤后的恶意植入样本，非随机自然流。
